## Introducing Odie
## Agentic customer intelligence engine for B2B post-sales teams.
Odie learns your company's hard-won customer knowledge – the history, their experience, the reasoning that drives successful outcomes – and combines it with ongoing AI analysis of your customer data.   

The result is a self-curating Customer Knowledge Engine: one brain that powers your team, the agents they build, and every add-on Odie tool they use.

## What Odie Is
## A brain to curate your living customer knowledge, and an add-on experience layer to turn knowledge into action.
  * ## The Brain
### Customer Knowledge Engine
Odie distills your customer data, your team's expertise, and your company's history into a living brain that powers the agents you've already built.
![Odie Living Narrative Index — Unison Standard Health Model dashboard](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a8c5c2cc59f906610b865ce/6a8ef6de8ec18451d3a34e14_c743e500704e1d5d1337060e87538e3c_odie-living-narrative-index.png)
  * ## The Optional UI experience
### Customer Operating System
Put the brain to work with a modern Customer Success Platform alternative – a guided workspace with embedded agents that keep up, not just keep record.
![Odie Customer Operating Engine — Enterprise Churn Propensity model](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a8c5c2cc59f906610b865ce/6a8ef6defa876966a43d18c7_31b25379bdcbfadadd204c31f4574535_odie-customer-operating-engine.png)


How Odie Works
Customer teams need _better_ AI. Getting there isn’t about more data — it’s about better human perspective.
### Capture
Purpose-built Odie agents interview your teams to learn about your company and customers, turning their perspective into structured knowledge that provides the context needed to analyze your data.
### Comprehend
Odie performs daily AI analysis of your customer data – CRM, usage, emails, calls, meetings, VOC, etc. – to predict outcomes, identify trends, and listen for signals you care about.
### Curate
Then the magic happens: Odie synthesizes all of that human knowledge and extracted data insights into an index of living customer narratives. These narratives are self-updating and form the foundation of Odie's customer intelligence infrastructure.
### Connect
Finally, Odie's MCP allows your teams to easily plug this living customer intelligence brain into any agent or tool your team already has.
Or
Into Odie’s optional add-on tools that are specifically designed to leverage this intelligence, such as our guided workspace experience — the Customer Operating System.
### With Odie,
your agents become:
  * highly specific to your business
  * relevant to each user
  * consistent over time
  * and cheaper to deploy


Because they know what your best humans know.

Pricing
## The bill you get is the bill you expect.
Predictable pricing. No black boxes. Odie is priced based on two key inputs:
Knowledge Maintenance
01
### Curation
Keeps your customer knowledge current.
  * Priced based on the individual entities – business units, customers, and employees – you want Odie to maintain knowledge for
  * And how often knowledge is refreshed


Knowledge Usage
02
### Draw
Puts your customer knowledge to work.
  * Priced by how you want to connect to the Customer Knowledge Engine
  * Your existing enterprise AI licenses, or any add-on Odie apps you purchase from us


#### No token pricing.
Tokens exist, but we take care of that for you.
#### No seat pricing.
Odie is accessible to everyone for the same price.
#### Two inputs your CFO can plan around.
A number you know before the quarter starts.
